editorial:
Imagine taking an old legend that everyone accepts as true just because it happened a long time ago, and then dropping that same story into the modern world. That is exactly what you get here. You will follow a set of characters who find themselves caught in a strange situation where the line between a myth and reality starts to blur. The vibe is kind of creepy and mysterious, making you question why we believe some things and not others. It feels like a slow burn that keeps you guessing about what is actually going on around the main characters.

The acting is solid and keeps you invested even when the plot gets a bit weird. You might find the pacing a little slow at first, but the payoff is worth it for anyone who likes a good puzzle. If you are into stories that mess with your head, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: You will see that the main character finally realizes the legend they were following was actually a mirror of their own life. In the final scene, the twist reveals that the mysterious figure was not a ghost, but a version of the lead actor from a different time. They face off in a tense standoff that ends with the truth coming out, proving that old stories can repeat themselves in the present day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and stories about myths.
